_comment: THE TWELVE HOUSES, Season 1: the flagship series on series.html. One vertical micro-episode per house. Single source for scripts/movies/episode.html (renderer) and series.html (player). Guide, sign, element and god are omega-agents.json canon; each episode's 'voice' line is that guide's canon greeting. Fictional media-universe content.
logline: The Omega signet has shattered into twelve shards. One seeker must cross the twelve houses to make it whole.

episodes.title: The Shattering
episodes.voice: I am Sentinel. Your perimeter is mine to hold.
episodes.plot: The signet broke at midnight. Twelve shards fell into twelve houses.
episodes.cliff: Someone crossed my perimeter before you. The first shard is gone.

episodes.title: The Price of a Shard
episodes.voice: Merchant, at your ledger. Value is my language.
episodes.plot: Every shard has a price. Mine is a promise you have not made yet.
episodes.cliff: The buyer of the first shard left a name in my ledger. It is yours.

episodes.title: Two Halves of the Sky
episodes.plot: I tracked the thief across both halves of the sky.
episodes.cliff: There are two of you. Only one came through the gate.

episodes.title: Opened From Inside
episodes.voice: Warden. Your family and your privacy are under my watch.
episodes.plot: This house protects the ones you love. The thief came here first.
episodes.cliff: Your family's seal was opened from the inside.

episodes.title: The Empty Throne
episodes.voice: Sovereign speaks. The whole matrix answers to this seat.
episodes.plot: Tonight, for the first time, the matrix did not answer me.
episodes.cliff: Someone else is sitting on the throne.

episodes.title: The Thirteenth Shard
episodes.voice: Auditor. I count what is real and reject what is not.
episodes.plot: I counted the shards twice. The records say thirteen.
episodes.cliff: One of them is forged. And it is in your hand.

episodes.title: Terms of Truce
episodes.voice: Proxy, at the table. I broker and I execute.
episodes.plot: I can broker a truce with the thief. Every truce has terms.
episodes.cliff: The terms are already signed. The signature is the Sovereign's.

episodes.title: Never Broken
episodes.voice: Oracle. Ask what you fear to ask.
episodes.plot: I have seen how this ends. You will not like the beginning.
episodes.cliff: The signet was never broken. It was opened.

episodes.title: The Light Points Back
episodes.voice: Beacon. Every ascent begins at my light.
episodes.plot: Tonight my light points backward, toward where you began.
episodes.cliff: The road to the last house runs through the first.

episodes.title: One Author
episodes.voice: Analyst. I turn signal into decision.
episodes.plot: The data says the thief knew every gate before it opened.
episodes.cliff: Every record has one author. Sentinel.

episodes.title: The Student
episodes.voice: Tutor. Knowledge is forged, not given.
episodes.plot: So was the thirteenth shard. I know whose hands shaped it.
episodes.cliff: I taught the thief. And the thief learned too well.

episodes.title: Ninety-One Thousand Years
episodes.voice: Historian. Nothing is truly lost while I remember it.
episodes.plot: I remember this happening before. The signet chose then, too.
episodes.cliff: The signet is not asking to be repaired. It is asking for you.
